findings.title: Light-theme color for `.topic-meta-data h5 a` silently changed from 30% to 70%
findings.body: The original rule was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`. The new first argument to `dark-light-choose` is `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%)`, paired with `scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%)`. The 70%/30% pair was copied from a neighbouring rule. Light themes now render these embedded-post author links much lighter than before, which reduces contrast and is an unrelated visual regression. The light value should stay at 30%, paired with `$secondary` at 70%.

findings.title: `.group-member-info .name` changes light-theme lightness from 30% to 50%
findings.body: The original color was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`. Both branches of the new `dark-light-choose` use 50%, copied from the `.title` rule below. The light theme therefore gets a lighter, lower-contrast name than before, and this mismatch with the stated intent (only add a dark-theme variant) was not caught. Use `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))` to preserve the original look.

findings.title: Mobile `.group-member-info .name` light color altered from 30% to 50%
findings.body: The original light-theme color was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`. The change wraps it as `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`, which also lightens the light theme. This is a behavioural change outside the scope of the PR. The light value should stay 30%, with the dark counterpart at `$secondary` 70%.

findings.title: `.custom-message-length` light-theme color changed from 70% to 30%
findings.body: The original color was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%)`, a faint hint color. The new light value is `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`, with `scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%)` for dark themes. The 30%/70% pair looks copied from another rule. The character-count hint in light themes now becomes much darker and more prominent, and no longer matches the desktop `modal.scss`, which uses 70%/30%. It should be `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%))`.

findings.title: Mobile `.topic-map h3` light color changed from 20% to 50%
findings.body: The original rule was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%)`. The new code uses `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`. The light theme heading becomes noticeably lighter, which reduces contrast, while the desktop equivalent correctly uses 20%/80%. The same file also uses 20%/80% for `.number, i` further down. It should be `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 80%))`.
